The actress who portrayed the titular character Corliss Archer in the 1945 film *Kiss and Tell* was Shirley Temple [[1]]. 

As an adult, Temple transitioned into public service and held several high-ranking diplomatic and government positions. She was officially appointed as the **United States Ambassador to Ghana** and later served as the **Ambassador to Czechoslovakia** [[5]]. Additionally, she held the official title of **Chief of Protocol of the United States**, where she was responsible for commissioning diplomatic appointments abroad [[5]].
